text:
Marta: tiny shoutout — huge thanks to Keon and Riley for hauling the spare standing desk up three flights this morning. saved my demo and my lower back :muscle:
Keon: team sport. cursed the stairs, blessed the broken elevator timing (jk). also shoutout to Zoe for the sandwich care package mid-lift :sandwich:
Riley: i carry heavy things for stickers. where's my sticker? :thinking_face::sticker:
Zoe: brought snacks, left motivational post-its, and found Marta's missing USB. labeled the allen key too. small wins. :tada:
Design: appreciate the heavy lifting on prototype day — demo looked clean. extra smooth handoff. :sparkles:
OfficeBot: [automated] Stairwell sensor: 3 trips detected at 08:47. Elevator status: out-of-service alert auto-filed. Coffee machine cycle completed at 09:05.
Marta: seriously, coffee + sticker ceremony at 4pm in the kitchen? short and sweet, heroes deserve a minute. :coffee: :medal:
Keon: i'll bring the sticker sheet. propose llamas or tiny laptops? :pensive:
Riley: llamas. strada de llamas. i'll carry the stickers up the stairs for symbolic justice. :llama:
Zoe: llama stickers are on me. 4pm it is. thanks again team :heart:
